strings.privacy.title: GilasArt Privacy Policy
strings.privacy.lead: This page explains how GilasArt uses and protects the information required to provide its services.
strings.privacy.collectionBody: For accounts and orders, GilasArt may receive a mobile number, name, delivery address, order information, and information needed for support. Technical visit data such as IP, country, and browser details may also be used for security and visitor analytics.
strings.privacy.useBody: Information is used to create and manage accounts, process orders and payments, send essential messages, provide support, improve the service, and prevent abuse. Public product and published content data are separate from private user information.
strings.privacy.providersBody: For operational services such as SMS and payments, only the information required for that service is sent to the relevant provider. Secrets such as API keys and user sessions are not exposed in the public frontend.
strings.privacy.securityBody: GilasArt uses HTTPS, secure sessions, access control, CSRF protection, request limits, and server-side security controls. No system can be guaranteed to be completely immune to every threat.
strings.privacy.rightsBody: Requests concerning an account, contact information, or correction of stored data can be submitted through support. Deletion of information required for legal or financial records may be subject to retention requirements.
strings.privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, use the GilasArt contact or support page.
